# lmw company posts

Show the latest posts of a company or school page

```
lmw company posts COMPANY [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw company posts anthropic -n 5
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help        help for posts
  -n, --limit int   number of posts (1-50) (default 5)
```
